reviewNotes: Twenty-five fishing, Junimo-scroll, save-menu, and map strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover placeholders, intentional Junimo spacing, established place and address names, time conversion, dynamic farm-name order, compact UI phrasing, punctuation, and capitalization; both found no remaining objective issue.

JunimoNoteMenu.cs.10786.source: We    the  Junimo are    happy to    aid  you.  In     return we     ask for gifts   of      the valley.    If you   are one     with    forest   magic    then you    will   see    the true    nature   of  this scroll.
JunimoNoteMenu.cs.10786.translation: Noi    Junimo  suntem    bucuroși să    te  ajutăm.  În     schimb îți     cerem daruri   din      vale.    Dacă ești   în armonie     cu    magia   pădurii,    atunci vei    vedea   adevărata    natură   a  acestui pergament.
